user.description: Family members and the schedule are set up afterwards under Configure.

data_description.language: Language for recipes, prompts and notifications. Independent of the Home Assistant language.
data_description.units: How amounts are written in the shopping list.
data_description.shopping_targets: To-do lists that receive the ingredients when you confirm the menu.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to suggest recipes when ICA recipes do not fit. Leave empty to skip AI suggestions.

data_description.generation_day: The menu is drafted on this day for the following week.
data_description.dinner_days: Days of the week that need a dinner.

data_description.person: Optional. Links the member to a Home Assistant person.
data_description.allergies: Hard rule: recipes with these ingredients are never suggested. Pick from the list or type your own.
data_description.dislikes: Avoided when possible. Type and press enter.
data_description.likes: Preferred when possible. Type and press enter.
data_description.attends: Days this person eats dinner at home.
data_description.cook_separately: On: a recipe containing this person's allergen can still be used when that ingredient can be swapped and cooked in clean, separate pans. Off: such recipes are never suggested. Turn off for severe allergies.

data.max_split_days: Dinners cooked in more than one version (at most)

data_description.style_tags: Recipes matching more of these are ranked higher.
data_description.vegetarian_days: Followed when enough suitable recipes exist.
data_description.fish_min: Followed when enough suitable recipes exist.
data_description.max_split_days: When someone cannot eat an ingredient (meat for a vegetarian, cream for a dairy allergy, pasta for gluten), a dinner can still be used if that ingredient can be swapped: they get an adjusted version. This limits how often per week.

data_description.sources: Sources are asked in a fixed order: store recipes first, then AI.
